design: Seven-node tree,2teacher directions per node, orthonormal14atom dictionary in20dimensions. Train single-node seeds and all leaf pairs, hold out leaf triples/all4. Supplied tree, seeds and taxonomy memberships. Train nested-union/additive-refinement/flat expanded-gate models from identical weights and minibatches. Matched594trainable parameters. Measure functional transfer, block subspace recovery and learned-component removal against true refinements.
limitations: Known hierarchy and gates; flat control receives closure as side information. Models intentionally functionally equivalent with this grouping, so no hierarchy superiority claim. One teacher,three seeds. Coordinates and dictionary are learned, topology is not.
